qs.q: Which structure forms the lateral walls of the nasal cavity during development?
qs.e: The maxillary process grows medially and contributes significantly to the lateral walls of the nasal cavity as well as the upper jaw. The frontonasal process forms the bridge and apex of the nose.

qs.q: A medical researcher is analyzing the cellular organization of the nasal cavity roof. Which of the following structures is located in the roof of the nasal cavity?
qs.e: The superior concha along with the upper part of the nasal septum are structures found in the roof of the nasal cavity. The inferior concha is a separate bone located lower down on the lateral wall of the nasal cavity.
